reason: The report controls for mgmt_rating_2023, which was measured in 2023 after the 2021-22 training and is strongly correlated with training (r≈0.54). It is therefore a post-treatment variable, and conditioning on it flips the sign. With only pre-period controls the training coefficient is about +0.50 (SE 0.22), versus -2.14 in the report, so the 'negative effect' conclusion is an artifact of the bad control.
